starts a published workflow -
it never mints a session

span.p:
credentials are write-only:
secret-flagged fields never leave

span.p:
THE BIND BOUNDARY - default 127.0.0.1
metis up listens on loopback. METIS_HOST=0.0.0.0
is the deliberate opt-in and prints a warning.
In a container the process binds 0.0.0.0 and
compose publishes 127.0.0.1:3000 instead

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unauthenticated by design
POST /api/auth/login
GET /api/oauth/callback
POST /hooks/:triggerId
the static editor bundle

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Webhook verification
HMAC-SHA256 over the raw bytes by default,
GitHub x-hub-signature-256, or standard-webhooks
with a 300 s replay window - all compared in
constant time. 'none' is selectable and means it

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bearer-gated
opaque token, 24 random bytes, held in memory,
so a restart ends every session.
Roles admin / editor / viewer, where 'view'
means only 'signed in'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Outbound URL guard
private and link-local ranges refused, every DNS
record checked, re-checked at every redirect hop.
A deadline on every outbound call

div.style: color: rgb(15, 46, 30) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SECRETS AT REST - .metis/credentials.enc
AES-256-GCM, fresh IV per write, published by
atomic rename so a crash cannot truncate the vault

div.style: color: rgb(15, 46, 30) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
.metis/credential.key - 32 random bytes, mode 0600.
It sits in the same directory as the ciphertext, so this
defends a stolen file, not a read of the disk

div.style: color: rgb(15, 46, 30) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE CODE STEP'S ISOLATE - isolated-vm
a fresh V8 isolate per run, 32 MB, 5 s default / 30 s cap.
No require, no fetch, no process, no fs, no timers - by
absence, not by a blocklist. Four pure host callbacks are
bridged in (hash, uuid, parse and format date);
values cross as JSON

div.style: color: rgb(58, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UNTRUSTED, outbound
whatever URL a workflow author typed
